test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Compete**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Compete **means to strive or struggle against someone or something in order to win or achieve a goal. (प्रतियोगिता में भाग लेना, मुकाबला करना)

 
 
• **Example**: The two teams will compete in the final
